defs.def: despite sth that you have just mentioned 尽管如此；不过；然而

ex.s: Nevertheless, it serves as a reminder that there are many ways to address problems of sustainability, and that you can make an amazing meal out of almost anything.
ex.t: 不过，它提醒我们，解决可持续性问题的办法有很多，而且你几乎可以用任何东西做出美味的饭菜。

ex.s: Nevertheless, this interview wasn’t a wasted opportunity.
ex.t: 尽管如此，这次面试并非浪费的机会。

ex.s: I was, nevertheless, talked into going on another fun-filled holiday in the wilderness.
ex.t: 尽管如此，我还是被说服再去荒野度过一个充满乐趣的假期。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.
ex.t: 这就是为什么，至少部分地，美国《国家气候评估》说：“没有‘一刀切’的适应。”尽管如此，有些行动收益大、风险和成本却小。

ex.s: As the then Poet Laureate, Robert Southey, wrote to one of them: "Literature cannot be the business of a woman's life, and it ought not to be." Nevertheless, the sisters didn't stop trying.
ex.t: 当时的桂冠诗人罗伯特·骚塞给她们中的一位写道：“文学不能、也不应当成为女人一生的事业。”尽管如此，姐妹们并未停止尝试。

ex.s: Nevertheless, looking on the bright side is the best thing that we can do for ourselves as well as for others.
ex.t: 尽管如此，看到光明的一面是我们能为自己和他人做的最好的事情。

ex.s: Those unable to decipher the hidden meaning know nevertheless that it is there, for it is felt in all wolf country, and distinguishes that country from all other land.
ex.t: 那些无法解读其中隐藏含义的人仍然知道它就在那里，因为这在所有狼的领地中都能感受到，并将那片土地与其他所有土地区别开来。

ex.s: Nevertheless, of all the characters I have known, perhaps Walden wears best, and best preserves its purity.
ex.t: 然而，在我所认识的所有人物中，也许瓦尔登的性格最经得起考验，也最能保持其纯洁。

ex.s: Nevertheless, there is still a long way to go before we can completely understand the workings of this complex organ.
ex.t: 尽管如此，要完全理解这个复杂器官的工作原理，还有很长的路要走。
